import re

def parse_grid_after(text, header):
    part=text.split(header,1)[1]
    rows=[]
    for line in part.strip().splitlines():
        toks=line.split()
        if len(toks)!=28 or not all(t.isdigit() for t in toks): break
        rows.append(list(map(int,toks)))
    return rows
